question: When may a predicate-based planar-face selector bind a downstream dependent feature, and when must the Harness stop as ambiguous?
model_class: dependent selection with symmetry or multiple eligible targets

ambiguity_or_fail_closed_conditions: candidate cardinality is zero or greater than one
predicate depends on input face enumeration
eligible targets require an unrecorded coordinate-only tie-breaker

constrained_hypothesis: A downstream feature may bind only when the declared live predicate yields exactly one eligible face; otherwise the result is ambiguous and no target is silently selected.

stopping_rule: do not substitute a coordinate-only rule
do not claim persistent naming or generic face recovery
do not change a parser, helper, IR, or runtime selector from this package alone

existing: face-selected-dependent-cut-v1 provides a family-bounded unique maximum-Z boss-top oracle and explicitly excludes multiple eligible faces.
missing_counterexample: a symmetric or otherwise multi-eligible target pair in which the same predicate returns ambiguous rather than binding either face
evidence.next_minimal_experiment: Completed by M29-002: the frozen twin-boss controls return ambiguous. Any extension must isolate a new selector ambiguity condition without relaxing this predicate.
